name: Watts On Data Reader
description: Once-daily private heating and water collection from Watts On. A persistent Android sidecar preserves the signed-in app session, while the collector requests the two most recent complete local days and stores only available readings. Trailing all-zero provider placeholders are withheld without discarding valid earlier zero-usage intervals.
short_desc: Once-daily Watts heating and water history collector.
author: Asger1002

form_fields.label: Daily snapshot time (24-hour HH:MM)
form_fields.hint: One attempt per local calendar day. A failed attempt is not retried that day; the next two-day overlap catches up automatically.

form_fields.label: IANA time zone
form_fields.hint: Controls both the schedule and local-day boundaries.
